decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Continuous arched timber border surrounds a single inset mirror; overlapping circular crown is gone.

rear.note: Rear is a continuous flat timber panel with a clean arch and no circular intersection.

detail.note: Close view shows vertical wood grain and even glass-to-frame separation.

underside.note: The mirror plane reflects the bright rig while the bottom frame remains closed and connected.

clay.note: Clay confirms a single uninterrupted arch and recessed mirror face.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Slender continuous arc curves above the drum shade and joins the round foot.

rear.note: Rear reveals the same smooth unbroken curve without the original straight rod corners.

detail.note: The shade wall is smooth and the stem ends inside its upper opening.

underside.note: Warm diffuser is seated inside the lower shade opening instead of floating below it.

clay.note: Clay retains the continuous tube, hollow drum and weighted layered base.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Smooth mushroom dome sits over a brass stem and pale weighted foot.

rear.note: Rear dome has an uninterrupted rounded profile and restrained soft highlights.

detail.note: Close view confirms smooth curved glass and fine stem surface detail beside the small base switch.

underside.note: Warm underside diffuser meets the glass rim and central stem without a detached disc.

clay.note: Clay shows the rounded dome, continuous stem and rounded circular foot.

decisions.reviewer: Codex root actual catalog five-view inspection

front.note: Continuous conical shade sits on articulated parallel brass arms and a round base.

rear.note: Rear retains connected pivots and smooth shade reflections without coarse radial facets.

detail.note: Close view resolves paired arms and end pivots against a softly curved spun shade.

underside.note: Open dark shade contains the seated pale bulb; base and pivots remain connected.

clay.note: Clay preserves the hollow shade, paired arms, pivot joints and layered weighted foot.
